evals.prompt: Make me a /standup command that pastes yesterdays commits and my open PRs into the prompt before Claude reads it.
evals.expected_output: A command with load-time shell injection and an argument hint.
expectations: A command with load-time shell injection and an argument hint.

evals.prompt: My /review-pr prints a literal placeholder when I pass only one argument. Fix the argument handling.
evals.expected_output: A corrected argument mapping accounting for zero-based indexing and missing arguments.
expectations: A corrected argument mapping accounting for zero-based indexing and missing arguments.

evals.prompt: I want /deploy to only run when I actually type it, never when Claude decides on its own.
evals.expected_output: disable-model-invocation set true, with the consequence for subagent preloading explained.
expectations: disable-model-invocation set true, with the consequence for subagent preloading explained.

evals.prompt: Write a /triage command that takes an issue number and a priority and drafts a response.
evals.expected_output: Named arguments declared in frontmatter and referenced in the body.
expectations: Named arguments declared in frontmatter and referenced in the body.

evals.prompt: Should this be a command or a skill? It needs a template file it fills in.
evals.expected_output: A recommendation of a skill because bundled files are needed, with the migration path.
expectations: A recommendation of a skill because bundled files are needed, with the migration path.
